properties.title: OOI CHLA profile metrics (0–200 m, 10 m bins) with OLCI matchups
properties.description:
CHLA metrics from OOI profilers and moorings (Mar 2024–Oct 2026), one row per instrument and 3 h window of local solar time, depth-binned 0–200 m in 10 m bins (A < depth <= B, as for Argo) from samples with qc_agg = 1, using true depths for fixed-depth instruments, and divided by the Sauzède et al. fluorescence:chlorophyll ratio for the site (column chla_ratio). Time is the mean time of the window's samples. Source: OOI ERDDAP. Matched to Sentinel-3 OLCI Level-3 4 km Daily Rrs (OLCIS3A_L3m_ERR_RRS, OLCIS3B_L3m_ERR_RRS; 11 bands 400–709 nm) for every profile on a day with an OLCI file (to 2026-10-01): the file of the profile's UTC day, nearest 4 km cell, S3A first then S3B. Columns pace_granule and pace_Rrs_valid flag whether the profile also has a PACE match, so OLCI can be compared with PACE on the same profiles or used on its own. OLCI Rrs is NaN where the pixel was masked.

How to load

ASSET_URL use 'Copy URL' on left

Python df = pandas.read_parquet('ASSET_URL')

R  df <- arrow::read_parquet('ASSET_URL')
